title: Sexy Coins
opening: Imagine a coin above a route you could walk. It catches your eye, then you decide whether walking fits what you are doing.

modes.label: Routine call
modes.description: A familiar, safe route may fit if you can still take part in the call.

modes.label: Difficult review
modes.description: If the review needs close listening and notes, leave the walk for later.

modes.label: Between heavy sets
modes.description: If walking could impair the set you came to perform, rest may preserve it.

labels.decision: Would you take this opportunity or leave it for now?
labels.reflection: Apply the cue in your day
labels.question: Where in an ordinary day could an imagined coin help you notice a movement opportunity, and when would you leave it alone to protect the main activity or recovery?
